_comment: EXAMPLE targets file for scripts/cr/verify_baselines.py summarize --targets <file>.
The binding targets are written by the baseline audit (scratchpad cr/baselines/baseline_targets.json,
generated by BL/scripts/build_targets.py); this file only shows the schema the tolerant reader accepts.
Top level: {'targets': [...]} (a bare list or {id: entry} also work).
Entry fields: id, method, benchmark, dim, n_init, init_type, budget, n_reps, metric, sense, values, source.
values: a list of {n, value, read_unc | se} (n = total evaluations incl. the initial design), or a dict
task -> such a list (GuacaMol), or {n: {mean, std, se}} (LassoBench pickle extract).
curve: 'best_so_far' (default) or 'value_at_eval' (the loss AT evaluation n, e.g. LassoBench's released
Random Search curves, which are not monotone).
Acceptance (audit conventions): |mean_repro - value| <= read_unc + 2*SE_repro with n_reps >= published.

targets.method: Vanilla BO (Hvarfner et al. ICML 2024, default: RBF ARD + DSP prior, qLogNEI, 4x(512 Sobol+512 around best))
targets.benchmark: LassoBench RealBenchmark(pick_data='dna'), objective = validation loss of evaluate(), x in [-1,1]^180
targets.x_convention: total evaluations incl. init (dotted line at 30 = end of DoE)
targets.source: arXiv 2402.02229v5 Fig. 7 (Lasso-DNA panel, blue "D-scaled p(l)"), crop BL/fig/hvarfner_fig7_lassodna-09.png; caption: 20 repetitions
targets.notes: Cross-check: Papenmeier Fig.8 DSP reads 0.3112/0.3016/0.2895/0.2854 at 100/200/500/1000 and Doumont Fig.2 RBF reads 0.311/0.302/0.290/0.285: three papers agree within 0.001.

targets.benchmark: LassoBench RealBenchmark(pick_data='dna'), loss of evaluate(), x in [-1,1]^180
targets.statistic: mean over repetitions of the loss at evaluation n (curve not monotone; std over reps given, n_reps not stored in the extract)
targets.source: LassoBench released results res_dna.pkl, extracted to cr/baselines/lassobench_pkl_extract.json

targets.method: TuRBO-1, Thompson sampling, batch 4 (BoTorch tutorial turbo_1)
targets.source: botorch tutorials/turbo_1/turbo_1.ipynb stored outputs ('N) Best value: ...'), cr/baselines/src/botorch
targets.notes: One run with batch 4; the repository's TuRBO-1 uses batch 1, success tolerance 3 (tutorial 10) and its own GP constraints, so agreement is a plausibility check, not a reproduction.
